name: Caso 4 - Autorizacion de supervisor con lector de tarjeta

planSteps.description: Click 'Iniciar Sesión con Microsoft'. On the Microsoft page type 'desarrollopy@pycca.com', click 'Next', type the password 'cdPY2027!*', click 'Sign in', and click 'Yes' if a 'Stay signed in?' prompt appears
The authenticated POS dashboard is visible (cards 'Facturación', 'Entrega de Caja', 'Historial de impresión')

PRECONDITION: click 'IR' on 'Facturación'. If a red notification says 'No puede acceder a esta funcionalidad porque tiene entregas de caja pendientes', go back to the dashboard, open 'Entrega de Caja', click 'Procesar', complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal by typing the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory), then type '1979' in 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'. Accept the success dialog and retry opening Facturación until it opens

load 10 articles: for each SKU (O23553, O24144, O28268, O48324, O48357, O60832, O60854, O78081, D01461, D01463) type it into the 'Buscar producto por SKU' field and press Enter; after each one set its row quantity to 3 and press Tab. If an article shows a red 'Pendiente' label, click it and fill every field (Homologacion='HOM-2026-001', Imei='359747505623812', Marca='GENERICA', Modelo='MODELO-TEST') then click 'Continuar'
Tick the header checkbox to select all products and click the future-delivery button (calendar icon) in the toolbar
An 'Autorización de Administrador' modal appears requesting 'Tarjeta de administrador' and 'Clave de administrador'

Inject the supervisor credentials: complete the 'Autorización de Administrador' modal: type the exact text '%21310300;432940;JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' into the 'Tarjeta de administrador' field followed by pressing Enter (the leading '%' and the Enter are mandatory; without them the app answers 'Formulario incompleto: cardNumber, frameData'), then type '1979' into 'Clave de administrador' and click 'Confirmar'
The authorization is ACCEPTED: the app navigates to the 'Entrega futura' screen and no error such as 'Lectura de tarjeta inválida' or 'Formulario incompleto: cardNumber, frameData' is displayed

SCOPE NOTE: verifying that the supervisor name 'JAIME GABRIEL HURTADO ALVAREZ' is printed in the signature/audit section of the voucher is NOT possible in this environment (no printer and no document preview). Report only whether the authorization itself succeeded
